object_description: compact low base with a light upper wood-and-glass structure
design_condition: Aligned with the existing building, the compact volume places a public reception space between the new building and canal while integrating the outdoor uses into the existing bathing complex.

positive.statement: The calm volumetric structure responds cleverly to the topographically demanding situation.
The proposal creates strong spatial and visual relationships across horizontal, vertical, and diagonal connections.
The indoor and outdoor pools complement each other through a strong spatial relationship between inside and outside.
The visibility of the swimming pool is suitable for competitions and provides enough spectator space despite the compactness.
The outdoor facilities are high quality, skilfully integrated, and convincingly arranged.
The ecological construction, efficient support system, and affordable expected building costs are welcomed.

negative.statement: The lack of a hairdressing area on the ground floor is not user-friendly.
Organizing the cloakrooms on two floors is cumbersome for users and makes orientation a challenge.
The location of the cloakrooms is unsuitable for using the outdoor pool.
The separation of the kitchen and storage room on two floors is operationally problematic.
The available space for right-of-way and parking appears tight.
The concept is ultimately judged unsustainable because of the organization of the cloakrooms on two floors.
